nodes.label: Default Settings (2 cores, 4 GB RAM, 20 GB disk, DHCP vmbr0)
nodes.norm_label: default settings (2 cores, 4 gb ram, 20 gb disk, dhcp vmbr0)

nodes.label: /root/moodle-credentials.txt
nodes.rationale: Admin and database passwords are random and stored inside the container.

nodes.label: update Command
nodes.rationale: Minor Moodle builds update normally; a new major version needs a separate yes together with the PHP and MariaDB it needs; PHP switch is rolled back if Moodle's checks fail.

nodes.label: $CFG->divertallemailsto on Test Site
nodes.rationale: Both copies share users and mail settings, so the test site must not email real people.

nodes.label: Separate MariaDB Encryption Key Folder
nodes.rationale: Copy the same key to a separate host folder so the two containers are not tied together; without it MariaDB in live does not start.

nodes.label: mp0 Encryption Key Bind Mount
nodes.rationale: pct clone may refuse to copy the bind mount, so remove it, clone, then restore it.

nodes.label: pct clone --full
nodes.rationale: Snapshot-free full clone requires the test container stopped for a few minutes.

nodes.label: Proxmox Backup Job
nodes.rationale: Jobs listing container IDs one by one do not include the new container automatically.

nodes.label: Moodle Site Re-registration
nodes.rationale: Both copies start with the same site identifier.

nodes.label: Copying a Test Moodle Container into a Live One
nodes.norm_label: copying a test moodle container into a live one

nodes.label: moodle-proxmox-installer
nodes.rationale: Installs the latest Moodle release in a new Proxmox LXC container (Ubuntu 24.04) with menus like the Proxmox VE community scripts.

nodes.label: Maintenance Mode + Pre-upgrade Backup (/var/backups/moodle)
nodes.rationale: Database and code backed up before Moodle changes (newest 3 kept); config.php and add-on plugins carried over; previous code and DB restored if upgrade fails. moodledata is not included, so Proxmox backups are still needed.

nodes.label: mdl_enrol.enrolperiod
nodes.rationale: Days x 86400 = seconds; set via SQL UPDATE on manual enrol rows, then caches purged.

nodes.label: ondrej/php PPA
nodes.rationale: Used because PHP versions newer than Ubuntu's own 8.3 are needed.

nodes.label: Runtime Version Lookup
nodes.rationale: Everything is looked up when the script runs: newest Moodle tag with a download package, newest PHP it supports (release notes), MariaDB minimum from environment.xml; falls back to Moodle 5.3 / PHP 8.4 / MariaDB 11.4 without internet.

nodes.label: local/adduser Plugin
nodes.rationale: Replaces Moodle's Add a new user form: requires a unique ID number, enrols in multiple courses via manual enrolment with default role, and sends a welcome email.

nodes.label: Default Enrolment Duration
nodes.rationale: Only affects new enrolments; existing enrolments keep their end date.

nodes.label: Enrolment Ends Option
nodes.rationale: Off by default so each course uses its own default enrolment duration; tick to end all chosen courses on one date.

nodes.label: Course Enrolment Durations (Live Site)
nodes.rationale: Set 2026-11-04: Class of Business courses 90 days, all others 30 days.
